column1: Create an observability overview dashboard for my hosts,"A host-centric overview dashboard:

column2: STATS rx_bytes_per_sec = SUM(RATE(system.network.in.bytes)), tx_bytes_per_sec = SUM(RATE(system.network.out.bytes)) BY host.name

column1: Create a CPU performance dashboard,"A CPU-focused dashboard:
- CPU breakdown by state (user / system / iowait)

column2: STATS user_pct = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(system.cpu.user.pct)), system_pct = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(system.cpu.system.pct)), iowait_pct = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(system.cpu.iowait.pct))
STATS avg_cpu_pct = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(system.cpu.total.norm.pct)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(5 minute)

column1: Build a memory utilization dashboard,"A memory-focused dashboard:

column2: STATS avg_memory_used_pct = AVG(AVG_OVER_TIME(system.memory.actual.used.pct)) BY bucket = TBUCKET(5 minute)

column1: Make a network traffic dashboard,"A network-focused dashboard:

column2: STATS rx_bytes_per_sec = SUM(RATE(system.network.in.bytes)), tx_bytes_per_sec = SUM(RATE(system.network.out.bytes)) BY system.network.name
